risks.title: High customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Risk factor positioned early in document and notes that top 10 customers represent 46% of 2025 sales. Language emphasizes lack of long-term contracts and risk of sudden sales loss. Concentration slightly increased vs prior year (43% in 2023). Competition category weighted moderately.

risks.title: Rising raw material costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeated multiple times, notably linked to US tariffs and inflationary pressures. Text indicates cost increases may not be passed through to prices, directly impacting margin. Language is strong (material impact on our profits). Upward trend with new tariffs announced. Industrial category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Labor shortage or elevated labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk well developed with mention of talent competition, rising costs and strike risks. Labor market described as highly competitive. Text emphasizes material impact on results. Intensity is high with upward trend driven by inflation. Industrial category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Production or distribution disruption
risks.score_rationale: Fire at Holly Ridge facility in August 2024 cited as concrete disruption example. Text mentions material impact on results, cash flow and potential customer loss. Strong language (reduction or elimination of product availability). Existential risk for single-source sites. Industrial category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Impact of obesity treatment therapies
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to rapidly expanding GLP-1 treatments. Text indicates risk of demand decline for certain product categories. Clear language on material impact. While recent, strongly contextualized. Competition category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Increased environmental regulation
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned with potential consequences for investment costs. However, language is cautious (cannot predict). No reference to recent actions or trend changes. Regulatory category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Uncertain acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: Risk well described (culture, costs, personnel) but without mention of recent or ongoing acquisition. Language is standard, lacking particular urgency. Mention of negative impact if failure but no concrete example. Capital category less heavily weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the text
